purpose: Original full schema with nested overlap decoding only

entities.requested_outcome: A distinct action, behavior, comparison or piece of information the user asks about. Extract the complete requested phrase, separating independently requested outcomes. Keep an inseparable comparison together.
entities.condition: A circumstance or premise restricting a requested outcome, including timing, existing state and configured values. Include its full wording.
entities.negative_constraint: A prohibition, exception or negative condition restricting a requested outcome. Include the negation and its object together.
entities.identifier: An exact software API name, dotted path, type expression or configuration property supplied in the question.
entities.literal: An exact supplied code value or quoted string, retaining punctuation and quotation marks.
entities.scope: An explicitly supplied software version, UI adapter or platform scope.
entities.subject: The object or entity that a requested outcome concerns, including a noun phrase needed to interpret a pronoun.
entities.unresolved_reference: A reference whose meaning cannot be uniquely determined from the question itself, because its referent is absent or multiple referents are plausible. Do not mark a pronoun with a clear referent.

relations.requires_context: Head is a requested outcome phrase; tail is a condition, negative constraint, subject, exact identifier, literal or version/adapter scope needed to interpret that outcome independently. Shared context links to each applicable outcome.
relations.refers_to: Head is a pronoun or referring phrase; tail is its uniquely identified antecedent in the question. Do not guess an ambiguous antecedent.

interpretation.clear: The question has a sufficiently clear interpretation, including pronouns whose referents are identifiable from the supplied text.
interpretation.ambiguous: A necessary referent or intended meaning is missing or has multiple plausible interpretations; clarification is needed before selecting an interpretation.

purpose: E5 record fields with natural per-action anchored record mode

fields.action: The action or information being asked about.
fields.condition: The full condition or negative constraint applying to this action.
fields.subject: The object this action concerns.
fields.code: Exact software names and code values needed for this action.

purpose: Researcher-inspired narrow explicit technical slots + broad intent; no decomposition or inferred concepts

entities.formly_api: Exact Formly API, property, class or function name
entities.error_message: Literal error message mentioned in the question
entities.form_name: Business-friendly name of an application form

intent.how_to: Asks how to implement or configure something
intent.explain: Asks what something does or why a behavior happens
intent.debug: Asks how to diagnose or fix an observed error
intent.compatibility: Asks whether a capability or configuration is supported
